blocks.text: Nicolas Villanueva, the crash victim who previously called out actor Niño Muhlach over his damaged motorcycle, has apologized to the actor and his family following the viral complaint. Villanueva posted his apology on Facebook on Wednesday, Sept. 16, addressing Muhlach, his wife Diane Abby Tupaz, and the actor’s sister, Angela Muhlach Hortaleza. “Isang taos-pusong paghingi ng paumanhin sa inyong lahat. Ako ay humihingi ng malalim na patawad sa aking mga nasabi at nagawa kamakailan,” Villanueva wrote.
